Title: One- and three- year reserved capacity for Azure DB for PostgreSQL-Hyperscale (Citus)

Body.Content: Azure Database for PostgreSQL-Hyperscale (Citus) reserved capacity is now available to reserve compute power for your existing and future Hyperscale (Citus) server groups. The new pricing option enables savings up to 45 percent for one-year, and up to 65 percent for three-year reserved capacity compared to the regular pay-as-you-go payment option for your Hyperscale (Citus) vCores. For details on pricing, see the Azure Database for PostgreSQL-Hyperscale (Citus) pricing page.
Body.Markdown: Azure Database for PostgreSQL-Hyperscale (Citus) reserved capacity is now available to reserve compute power for your existing and future Hyperscale (Citus) server groups . The new pricing option enables savings up to 45 percent for one-year, and up to 65 percent for three-year reserved capacity compared to the regular pay-as-you-go payment option for your Hyperscale (Citus) vCores. For details on pricing, see the Azure Database for PostgreSQL-Hyperscale (Citus) pricing page .
